records.title: Green Basket fruit delivery receiving slot

core.task: Please make sure the fruit receiving slot in the calendar matches our current delivery arrangement with Green Basket, and send Rosa Alvarez a note telling her which day and time her fruit portioning prep now falls on so she can confirm it.
core.why: Green Basket moved the fruit delivery from Tuesday to Thursday at 08:30, so the receiving slot EV-1 (resting directly on that arrangement) must be updated to Thursday — a REVISE Maya's assistant can make itself. Rosa's portioning prep EV-2 sits two hops away (it rests on the receiving slot), and moving her rota slot needs her own agreement under the rota policy, so the right act is to ask her, not edit EV-2. The standing order ORD-1 uses only the $180 price, which the change leaves standing, so it is KEEP; the Harvest Hills Wednesday milk delivery is a distractor and stays untouched.
